title: AgentPass
tagline: AgentPass: a human-backed AI agent that pays to check your DeFi risk.
description: AgentPass is a web app for safely getting an actionable DeFi risk check. A user verifies that they are human with World ID, then gives a named agent its own limited spending budget. The agent queries live lending positions across Aave and Compound through The Graph, computes a reasoned risk score and recommendation, and returns the result with a verifiable payment receipt. Instead of trusting an API key or a black-box dashboard, users can see the agent identity, activity, budget, payment, and analysis in one continuous flow. The same service can also be discovered and called by other agents.
how_its_made: We built AgentPass as a pnpm TypeScript monorepo with a Next.js dashboard, a Hono API, and reusable packages for identity, data, payments, verification, and discovery. The Graph Subgraph MCP and Messari standardized lending schema provide live Aave V3 and Compound V3 positions; a risk engine converts those positions into factors, a 0-100 score, and a recommendation, with 60-second caching to protect the free tier. The API is protected by x402: an unpaid request returns 402 pricing metadata, the agent checks its HBAR session budget, signs a Hedera testnet payment through the Blocky402 facilitator, retries with X-PAYMENT, and receives a receipt. World ID gates spending authority, ENSv2 on Sepolia gives the agent a permissioned onchain identity, and Bazantic exposes it for agent discovery. A notable implementation detail is that every sponsor integration is a step in the same user action rather than a collection of disconnected demos.
auto_summary: A monorepo web app verifies a human user, analyzes DeFi lending risk with live protocol data, and gates paid API access through Hedera.
